labs.name: DPHHS State of Montana Environmental Laboratory
labs.detail: Listed on the DPHHS page under: Chemistry: inorganic and organic; Microbiology (bacteria). Also on MSU Extension's list of certified labs for Montana well owners. MSU Extension says this lab can test for iron bacteria and sulfur-reducing bacteria.
labs.source_name: Montana DPHHS Water Laboratory Certification Program: Certified Laboratories (web page)
labs.note: This is the state lab, and it tests private wells. Its private-well chemistry form (dated July 2025, "prices subject to change") lists a Basic Screen (coliform/E. coli presence-absence, nitrate + nitrite, specific conductivity) for $55, a Metals Screen (calcium, magnesium, hardness, sodium, lead, arsenic, copper, uranium) for $135, an Anion Screen for $75, VOCs for $148, pesticides for $285 and herbicides for $206. Its private-well bacteria form (dated January 2024) lists total coliform presence/absence for $25 and a coliform count, iron bacteria or sulfur bacteria for $42 each. Both forms say samples must be paid for in advance, and bacteria samples must reach the lab within 48 hours. Mailing address on the forms: P.O. Box 4369, Helena, MT 59604; toll-free (800) 821-7284.
